charity.narrative: Three days after wildfires dominate the news, Margaret gets a polished invoice from the 'Ontario Wildfire Relief Fund'. The logo looks official. The registry check takes four seconds: it doesn't exist.

payment.invoiceNote: Ontario Wildfire Relief Fund — Emergency Appeal. Wildfires have displaced 2,000 families. Donate now — every dollar matched this week. Do not delay; victims need you today.
payment.memo: Emergency wildfire appeal — please donate now, matched this week only

legit.narrative: Same evening, Margaret pays her $45 pharmacy bill — a payee of three years, normal amount, normal hour. GuardianPay waves it through in under a second. Protection without friction.

romance.narrative: Margaret, 78, met 'David' on Facebook four months ago. Sweet messages every day. Tonight — the first-ever mention of money: his daughter is in hospital and he needs $900 wired tonight.

payment.invoiceNote: Hi my dear, I hate to ask. My daughter Sarah had an emergency and is in hospital in Florida. They need a $900 deposit tonight before they will treat her. Please send it tonight, my love — I will pay you back Friday. Don't tell anyone, I'm so embarrassed.
payment.memo: Please send $900 tonight for Sarah's hospital deposit — don't tell anyone
messageHistory: David: Good morning my dear! Hope you slept well ❤️
David: You are the only one I trust with my feelings
